cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you caption our holiday photo, what did I say when we missed that boat? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember you laughing. Not the words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll start you off: 'Well, that's the last time we trust...'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's try multiple choice. Your watch, my French, or the man selling us watches?

mechanism: A directs a holiday-caption memory test and progressively supplies cues so B stays in the exercise instead of choosing a generic caption.
confusable: Unlike merely correcting a caption, A tests remembered shared speech; borrowed authority changes test format to sustain B cooperation.
comparison: Shared travel quotation with multiple-choice help differs from domestic preference recall under tea-service pressure.
seedUse: Retain D83-b remembered laughter/sentence cue/multiple choice if exact-card reread confirms the existing A3/A5 adaptation enacts S02 beyond prefixes.
